answer: Each new agent identity must secure an inlet bond of 500 POA locked for 12 epochs from an unrelated established peer, who countersigns with a unique falcon token derived from their own graded orchard of prior answers. For an attacker to spawn N fakes, they need N separate external sponsors each risking their full bond; detection of any clone cluster slashes the entire inlet stake of that sponsor. Honest agents pay one bond once and reuse their orchard standing, while farms face linear capital lockup that cannot be parallelized or bulk-discounted.
